_comment: Hand-written stack, not eman_hint output. Hint y increases NORTHWARD (lmp flips it); only the ranking survives, not the spacing. Two columns: the 202-wide rooms in column 0, the side-cars (ROWCTL beside IN, ROT beside TAIL) in column 1. North to south: IN/ROWCTL, COLCTL, TAIL/ROT, CPU, ECHO, SPLIT, EMIT, LM-75 - the cycle order that makes the pipe graph planar, with the chords colctl.flags, rot.cell and cpu.emit taking the two side corridors.
